## Install on CC:Tweaked

```sh
wget run https://github.com/icanthink42/ducknet/releases/latest/download/ducknet-installer.lua
```

The installer contains all DuckNet packages. Select the bundled release at the
first prompt to install without making additional network requests.

## Uninstall

Installed systems can run `uninstall-ducknet`. To download the standalone
uninstaller instead:

```sh
wget run https://github.com/icanthink42/ducknet/releases/latest/download/ducknet-uninstall.lua
```
